thesis_statement: CIA Triad - Information security fundamentally relies on maintaining Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability
formal_proof: Derived phenomenologically and logically through human consensus.
context_description: A fundamental axiom belonging to the missing epistemological pillars of Phase 8.

thesis_statement: Zero Trust Architecture - No entity (internal or external) is trusted by default; all access requires strict identity verification
